history.summary: All acceptance criteria verified met. Documentation comprehensive and accurate. No runtime behavior changed. Docs gate working. Synthetic values only. RFC header rationale explicit. Release note ready. Scope properly bounded.
The documented form migration example does not match a real executable API business contract.
The documentation gate is not wired into CI and misses common form/raw syntaxes while rejecting unrelated Authorization schemes.

Fixed all three iteration-1 review findings, docs/test/CI-only: (1) replaced the non-executable form migration example with real query/form/raw/Bearer examples against POST /api/campaigns/{id}/complete (exact route, method, no trailing slash) and added controllers/api/campaign_transport_deprecation_test.go, an executable regression dispatching every transport through the real API router and asserting each one authenticates and actually completes its campaign, plus a trailing-slash negative case; (2) replaced the grep-based docs gate with internal/docsguard, a stdlib-only Go package with fixture-based positive/negative table tests covering every supported deprecated syntax (query api_key, curl -d/--data/--data-raw/--data-urlencode/-F/--form, standalone api_key=) and every legitimate Authorization scheme (Bearer/Basic/Digest/Negotiate/NTLM) case-insensitively, wired through a new cmd/docsguard CLI and scripts/verify-docs-canonical-examples.sh; (3) added a blocking docs-guard job to .github/workflows/ci.yml, wired into ci-success, reusing already-pinned action SHAs and the repository's default minimal permissions. No runtime auth/middleware/header/status/warning/version/dependency change. VERSION unchanged (0.12.1).
